question: Who is the only Cricket Player to win "Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mithali Raj.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mithali Raj** is a** female Indian cricketer** who is considered as one of the greatest female cricketers of all time.
 
• She is the **captain** of the** Indian Women's cricket team**.
 
• Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award is the** highest sporting honour** in India.
 
• It is awarded annually by the** Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** to recognize the excellence in sports by an individual or a team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Virat Kohli **is a renowned **Indian cricketer **and the** current captain** of the Indian Men's cricket team.

 
 
• He has won many awards and accolades for his outstanding performances in cricket, including the** Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy for ICC Cricketer of the Year in 2017 and 2018.**
 
 
 
• **Rohit Sharma **is another popular **Indian cricketer **who is known for his incredible batting skills.
 
 
• He has won many awards and recognitions for his performances in **cricket, **including the **Wisden Leading Cricketer in the World in 2019.**
 
 
 
• **Harmanpreet Kaur** is a **female Indian cricketer** who is known for her explosive batting and excellent fielding skills.
 
 
• She has won many awards and accolades for her performances in cricket, including the **Arjuna Award in 2017.**
